headline: Continual learning
that runs on the edge.
lede: Undergraduate researcher building video models that keep learning after deployment — on CPUs and embedded GPUs, not clusters. I read a lot of papers about it, and write down what actually held up.
affiliation: Seoul National University of Science and Technology

projects.name: coad-mini
projects.tagline: continual learning for streaming video action recognition
projects.body: End-to-end pipeline learning new actions over 8 sequential stages without catastrophic forgetting, plus few-shot enrollment with live model hot-swap and OOD detection. Shipped as a FastAPI webcam demo.

projects.name: KBO outcome prediction
projects.body: ~60 engineered features over 2,435 games (2023–2026), an Optuna-tuned gradient-boosting ensemble with Platt calibration, reaching ROC-AUC ≈ 0.70. Diagnosed and fixed a feature-staleness leak in the rolling-stat blend.

projects.name: PPO from scratch
projects.body: Actor-critic, GAE and rollout buffer written from scratch for CarRacing-v3 from raw pixels; traced a training collapse to three root causes and recovered a stable agent at clean mean ~667.
